pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of secondary entries or pyramiding when floating drawdown exceeds 1.5 ATR on the primary position; zero additions into falling knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume delta confirmation and zero-latency spread thresholding (< 30 pips) required prior to order execution to avoid news wick entrapment.
profit_harvest_threshold: Dynamic trailing stop activation at +$10.00 floating profit, locking in guaranteed floors while permitting runner scaling up to the $15-$30 objective window.
